sentences.en: But I suspect I would.
sentences.zh: 但我猜我还是会这么觉得。

sentences.en: I hope this gets better.
sentences.zh: 希望后面会好起来。

sentences.en: And he goes on to point out some of the things he liked about it, but that it had just kind of been stretched out maybe more than it needed to be.
sentences.zh: 他接着指出了一些他喜欢的点，但也提到这一集可能确实被拉得太长了，没必要那么久。

sentences.en: Listen, I felt that.
sentences.zh: 听着，我能理解那种感觉。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I felt that, but I also know that the things that hit in this episode, they couldn't have been done in 22 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我能理解，但我也知道，这一集里那些精彩的瞬间，如果只有22分钟是拍不出来的。

sentences.en: So sorry if you had to sit through a couple of repetitive beats, but it's what needed to be.
sentences.zh: 所以很抱歉让你们忍受了一些重复的节奏，但这是必须的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then at the end of his review, he said this.
sentences.zh: 然后在评论的最后，他说了这样一段话。

sentences.en: I didn't talk about the Angela story because I didn't want to go into too much detail, but her life sucks now that she's left the state senator.
sentences.zh: 我没谈安吉拉的故事，因为我不想写得太详细，但她离开州参议员后的生活简直糟透了。

sentences.en: Her cats were seized, she got evicted from her apartment, and is apparently a double-digit bank transfer away from indigents.
sentences.zh: 她的猫被没收了，被赶出了公寓，而且离赤贫似乎只差几次银行转账了。

sentences.en: I'd love for Dwight and Angela to end up together, but I wish the writers had chosen a path that didn't involve Angela being reduced to nothing firSt.
sentences.zh: 我很希望德怀特和安吉拉能在一起，但我希望编剧选择的路径不是先让安吉拉一无所有。

sentences.en: That said, an uptight gay Mexican sharing an apartment with the differently uptight school marm whose ex-husband is his former lover?
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，一个拘谨的墨西哥裔同性恋，和一个同样拘谨、前夫还是他前任情人的女教师合租公寓？

sentences.en: Question mark?
sentences.zh: 问号？

sentences.en: The words, the office spinoff usually make me break out, but in all caps, that is a show I would watch.
sentences.zh: “办公室衍生剧”这几个字通常让我起鸡皮疙瘩，但如果是这个设定，我绝对会看。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I always felt that way too.
sentences.zh: 我一直也是这么想的。

sentences.en: I was like, Angela and Oscar sharing an apartment?
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想，安吉拉和奥斯卡合租一套公寓？

sentences.en: Sign me up.
sentences.zh: 算我一个。

sentences.en: It's like the odd couple.
sentences.zh: 简直就像《单身公寓》一样。

sentences.en: I wish we could see more of that.
sentences.zh: 真希望我们能多看到一些那样的情节。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, I'll have you know that critically, this episode was very well received.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我得告诉你，从评论角度来看，这一集非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: And in fact, these last six episodes, Live in the Dream Part 1, Live in the Dream Part 2, AARM Part 1, AARM Part 2, Finale 1 and 2,
sentences.zh: 事实上，最后这六集，即《活在梦中》第一部分、《活在梦中》第二部分、《AARM》第一部分、《AARM》第二部分，以及大结局第一和第二部分，

sentences.en: this block of six episodes were rated the highest among office tally.com viewers as well.
sentences.zh: 这六集在 office tally.com 的观众中评价也是最高的。

sentences.en: There is this stretch here where we got people excited, like the critics and fans alike.
sentences.zh: 在这一阶段，我们让人们感到兴奋，无论是评论家还是粉丝都一样。

sentences.en: They liked where this was going.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢剧情的发展方向。

sentences.en: Well, by this time, we're all so invested in these characters and big life stuff starts happening.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到了这个时候，我们都已经深深投入到这些角色中，而重大的人生转折也开始发生了。

sentences.en: Well, that's the end of this episode.
sentences.zh: 好了，这一集到此结束。

sentences.en: Thank you, Steve Burgess, for all of your behind-the-scenes tidbits.
sentences.zh: 感谢你，史蒂夫·伯吉斯，感谢你带来的所有幕后花絮。

sentences.en: And thank you all for writing in.
sentences.zh: 也感谢大家的来信。

sentences.en: And Angela, thank you for your nifty gifties.
sentences.zh: 还有安吉拉，谢谢你送的精美小礼物。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: And thank you, Mary.
sentences.zh: 还有谢谢你，玛丽。

sentences.en: Beatrice.
sentences.zh: 是比阿特丽斯。

sentences.en: Davidson-Kinner.
sentences.zh: 戴维森-基纳。

sentences.en: Yes, for inventing the toilet paper roll hook and sanitary napkin.
sentences.zh: 是的，感谢她发明了卫生纸卷挂钩和卫生巾。

sentences.en: When she did the sanitary belt specifically, she did it with her sister, Mildred Davidson-Austin Smith.
sentences.zh: 当她专门发明卫生带时，是和她的姐妹米尔德丽德·戴维森-奥斯汀·史密斯一起完成的。

sentences.en: So it was two sisters.
sentences.zh: 所以是两姐妹。

sentences.en: Two sisters helping ladies out.
sentences.zh: 两姐妹在帮助女士们解决难题。

sentences.en: I mean, amazing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，太了不起了。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, there you go.
sentences.zh: 好了，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's Living the Dream Part 2, everybody.
sentences.zh: 各位，以上就是《活在梦中》第二部分的内容。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: We love doing this.
sentences.zh: 我们很喜欢做这个节目。

sentences.en: And we hope you have a great day.
sentences.zh: 希望大家度过愉快的一天。

sentences.en: We'll see you next week.
sentences.zh: 我们下周见。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士》。
